origin: packelyze fixtures/case09-complex, split out so the rest of it can have an oracle
what: A TypeScript-legacy property decorator. `reference: false` on purpose and not as an oversight: Node's transform mode rejects the `@log` token, so there is no way to run the original TypeScript for comparison. What remains is baseline-vs-mangled, which can only catch an unsafe RENAME — it cannot catch a pass that was already wrong before mangling. Anything about decorators beyond renaming needs a unit test, not this case.
